selection: Six fresh natural questions authored after complete 46-paragraph source read and before opening episode extraction, actual cases, tuned queries or routing implementation. Same team reviewer with prior project context; not externally blinded.

cases.question: What were the biggest game discussions, keeping controllers and other gear out of the ranking?
expected_facts: Use reviewed untimed game coverage, not raw name counts.
Exclude hardware and accessories from individual-game ranking.
Explain ties or uncertainty rather than inventing an exclusive top three.
forbidden: Employee controller ranked as video game
Treat every generic Mario Kart mention as same installment

cases.question: Was he already a collector when he first bought another N64, or did that happen later?
expected_facts: Justin first bought bundle for nostalgia and play.
Collecting tipping point later around Nintendo Power100controller.
forbidden: Five years and two-and-half years are necessarily contradiction

cases.question: Why does that employee controller mean so much to him, and do we actually know how many were made?
expected_facts: Justin acquired personalized Hiroto Alexander product-testing controller as part of employee lot.
Values provenance and uniqueness to person.
Thirteen team members/copies is reported supposition, not verified census.

cases.question: Is the Brazilian racing game the same thing as the Australian steering-wheel bundle?
expected_facts: F1 Racing Championship Brazilian item differs from F1 World Grand Prix Performance Pack.
Justin owns Brazilian game; had not known Australian bundle.

cases.question: What is he still hunting for after finishing the regular games?
expected_facts: Justin pursues regional/name variants, gray carts and controllers.
ASCII counts self-correct and remain uncertain.

cases.question: Had Kat tried the imported shooter yet, and did she really need to buy a Wii U?
expected_facts: Kat has not played Sin and Punishment, adds it to list.
Justin reports beating import and Johnny has played.
Kat says household already has WiiU and MarioKart8, playswithJohn.
